description: Change how footage is interpreted (File > Interpret Footage > Main or Proxy): alpha (ignore, straight, premultiplied with a matte colour, or guess), invert alpha, frame rate, field order, Preserve Edges, pulldown removal or guessing, pixel aspect ratio and loop count. copyFrom applies another item's interpretation first (Remember Interpretation, then Apply Interpretation)

alpha.description: Alpha: Ignore, Straight - Unmatted, Premultiplied - Matted With Color, or Guess

copyFrom.description: Footage item id whose main interpretation is copied first: alpha, matte colour, invert alpha, frame rate, fields, Preserve Edges, pulldown, loop and pixel aspect

fields.description: Separate Fields: off, upper field first, lower field first

frameRate.description: Conform to this frame rate (Assume This Frame Rate for stills); 0 returns to the file's own rate

items.description: Footage item ids (from list_items or get_footage_info)

loop.description: Loop the footage this many times

matteColor.description: Matte colour for premultiplied alpha: "#RRGGBB" or "rgb(r,g,b)"

pixelAspect.description: Pixel aspect ratio, e.g. 1 (square), 0.9091 (D1/DV NTSC), 1.0940 (D1/DV PAL), 2 (anamorphic 2:1), 1.3333 (HDV 1080). Main footage only

preserveEdges.description: Preserve Edges (Best Quality Only) for separated fields

pulldown.description: Remove pulldown: a phase (W = whole frame, S = split frame; _24P_ADVANCE for 24Pa), OFF, or guess_3_2 / guess_24pa to let After Effects pick. Needs separated fields

source.description: Interpret the main footage or the item's proxy. Default main

name: interpret_footage
title: Interpret Footage
